description: Content-address and verify any bytes, where the bytes already are
trust: no server is trusted: hashing runs where the bytes are, and every published document is named by its own blake3

addresses.sha256: sha256:<64 hex> — interoperable (RFC 9530, OCI, Hugging Face LFS)
addresses.blake3: blake3:<64 hex> — fast; manifests are addressed with it
addresses.gitsha1: gitsha1:<40 hex> — the Hub's Git blob hash, sha1("blob <len>\0" + bytes)

fetch_verified.shell: curl -sL URL -o FILE && echo "<hex>  FILE" | sha256sum -c - || rm -f FILE

coverage: any bytes for address/verify; the most-downloaded public, ungated Hugging Face models for resolve, refreshed daily
